{{Top|leg}}
The '''Citizen's Security Clearance''' was a type of security clearance that was held by citizens of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Samara Mindak]] and the exposure of [[Theovor Mindak]]'s ties to terrorist groups, [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] began investigating the friends and associates of the [[Mindak family]], and froze their credit accounts, transport passes, and clearances.
